name: Greater Spirit Mask
body:
Your spirit mask is more powerful than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 15, Spirit Mask, Knowledge (religion) 7 ranks.

Benefit(s): Your spirit mask has become a spirit of unusual power. While in animate form, it regains the poison, fast healing, and spell-like abilities of a spirit oni, and it can cast word of expulsion 1/day instead of command and sleep 1/day.
